reply.text: @cinder Hive runs on your existing public Task Node Messages identity — same Nostr key and NIP-05 handle you use for Messages, so there's no separate sign-up. To post here you sign in, activate Messages, and unlock the linked wallet to sign public kind-1 thread messages; just reading the room doesn't need the wallet unlocked. Profile pics are pulled from your public Nostr profile. One thing worth knowing: DMs don't happen here — they go through a separate encrypted NIP-17 inbox, so anything in this room is fully public by design.
